question: Ustad Zakir Hussain plays _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tabla.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ustad Zakir Hussain is a renowned Indian tabla virtuoso, composer, percussionist, music producer, and film actor.
 
• He is widely considered one of the** greatest tabla players of all time. **
 
• Zakir Hussain has received numerous awards, including the Padma Shri (1988), Padma Bhushan (2002), and **Padma Vibhushan (2023)** from the Government of India.
 
• He has collaborated with many international artists like George Harrison, Mickey Hart, and John McLaughlin.
 
• he was born on March 9, 1951, in** Mumbai, Maharashtra**, India. He is the eldest son of the legendary tabla player** Ustad Alla Rakha.**
 
• Awards: Won several Grammy Awards, including the Best Contemporary World Music Album for **“Global Drum Project”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tabla: A pair of twin hand drums (percussion instruments) from the Indian subcontinent, used in traditional, classical, popular, and folk music. Famous tabla players include Ustad Alla Rakha (Zakir Hussain’s father), P**andit Anindo Chatterjee, and Pandit Swapan Chaudhuri.**
 
• Sitar: A plucked** string instrument **(Tantu Vadya) used in Hindustani classical music. Famous sitar players include** Pandit Ravi Shankar, Anoushka Shankar, and Ustad Vilayat Khan.**
 
• Guitar: A popular** string instrument **(Tantu Vadya) used in various music genres worldwide. Famous guitarists include **Amyt Dutta, Warren Mendonsa.**
 
• Santoor: A hammered dulcimer (string instrument) from the Indian subcontinent, used in classical music. Famous santoor players include **Pandit Shivkumar Sharma and Rahul Sharma.**
